# Reproducer: #8076 — mvcc: TRUNCATE checkpoint can discard acknowledged concurrent commits with passive checkpointing enabled

https://github.com/tursodatabase/turso/issues/8076

## Environment

- Commit: 665cf5b2c80c3f76b6652ab102d7da2cd470f904
- Platform: linux x86_64
- Reproduced at: 2026-09-22T09:33:39Z

## Reproduce

```sh
RUSTFLAGS='--cfg tokio_unstable --cfg shuttle' cargo test -p turso_stress --test shuttle_issue_8076
```

Fails on the current tree; passes once the bug is fixed.

## What happens

Confirmed on the current tree: with passive MVCC checkpointing enabled, a TRUNCATE checkpoint racing concurrent single-row inserts reports success and all rows are visible before restart, but after a clean close-and-reopen the writer's later acknowledged commits are gone (only ids 1-269 of 385 survive), so the checkpoint discards durable committed data.
